name: Scroll of Messaging
summary: In Stonetalon, Gaxim Rustfizzle prepares to send a message that will set off explosives from afar.

sections.title: A Volatile Message
sections.body: At the Venture Company's logging operation, Gaxim Rustfizzle will turn a message into a blast. He plans to join the scroll's transmission incantation with volatile NG-5 charges. The explosion will draw the guards away. Then operatives can slip past and steal engineering schematics and confidential correspondence.

faq.q: What is the Scroll of Messaging used for?
aliases: what does scroll of messaging do
faq.answer: Gaxim Rustfizzle uses the Scroll of Messaging's transmission magic to trigger NG-5 from afar. Together, they let him set off an explosion at a distance.

aliases: where do i bring scroll of messaging
faq.answer: Gaxim Rustfizzle, a gnome engineer in the Stonetalon Mountains, receives the scroll.

faq.q: Why does Gaxim need a remote explosive?
faq.answer: Gaxim needs a major diversion at the Venture Company operation. The chaos will cover an infiltration, the theft of engineering plans, and the recovery of documents meant to halt the company's clear-cutting of the forest.
NG-5 is an explosive chemical charge used by Gaxim Rustfizzle. Joined to the scroll's magical signal, it forms a remote detonator.

angles.text: The scroll shows how gnomish engineering can use arcane magic to receive a signal and set off explosives from afar.
For Alliance operatives, the scroll helps sabotage Venture Company machinery and hinder its destruction of the Stonetalon forest.
